lots.guide_summary: All surviving same-item (close) evidence is SOLD, from eBay completed sales aggregated by PriceCharting (mainly UK/EU sellers): A$303 to A$751 at 1.4328 AUD/USD, with the worn-box or condition-unstated boxed sales clustered at A$303 to A$460 and tested clean boxes at A$647 to A$751. No UNSOLD evidence. Two eBay AU asks (A$700, A$850) are snippet-only leads. PriceCharting's own guide reads US$239.56 loose and US$561.92 complete. No Australian auction-house or LiveAuctioneers result for a Mega-CD II was found (LiveAuctioneers archive searches for 'sega mega cd 2' and 'mega cd' returned only Mega Drive games and Sony CD players).
lots.working: Keep: lowest same-item SOLD in 24 months = US$211.42 x 1.4328 = A$302.9 (poor box, tested, 2026-08-21). 302.9 / 1.198 = 252.8, rounded down to $250. This assumes the unit is inside the box; if Gowans says it is empty or the unit is missing, the lot is a box-only item (empty boxes sold US$30 to US$85 in 2022-24 on the same page, older than 24 months) and the bid should drop to about $20. Flip: likely resale about A$300 for a worn-box untested unit (the lowest boxed sales; untested loose sold only A$102), less eBay AU fees about 13.4% (A$40) and tracked outbound postage about A$25 = A$235. 235 / 2.396 = 98.1, rounded down to $95. Buyer's premium 19.8%, inbound freight $0 (pickup 37 Main Road, Moonah).
